title: DabAI job status (<out_dir>/status.json, GET /jobs/{id})
description: Rewritten atomically every ~3 s while the job runs; final when status is not QUEUED / RUNNING. Fields may be added in later dabai-job/2 versions (ignore unknown fields); removing or renaming one bumps the schema to dabai-job/3.

status.description: TZ 3.3. SUCCESS / PARTIAL_SUCCESS carry a video; ERROR / TIMEOUT do not.

step.description: queued, download, precheck, upright, cfr, face_res, audio, sep, polyglot, pace_fix, face_gen, face_comp, face_hires, subs, mux, end (+ wait_* in a shared worker)

step_label.description: English label for the waiting screen (TZ 2.10).

progress_pct.description: Approximate, never goes backwards within a job.

warnings.description: User-facing notes of a SUCCESS / PARTIAL_SUCCESS job.

flags.description: All pipeline flags, technical ones included (low_res, face_work_downscaled, ...).

messages.description: v1 name of warnings (flag, en, ru).

output.description: The dubbed video (H.264 MP4, source resolution / fps / aspect, AAC).

outputs.description: bed name -> video path (both beds with output.both_beds).

subs_ass.description: The ASS subtitles (also burned in when subs.enabled).

video_minutes.description: Input duration: what the user is charged for.

gpu_busy_s.description: NVML GPU-busy seconds of this job (TZ 1:5 accounting).

refund_suggested.description: true for ERROR / TIMEOUT / PARTIAL_SUCCESS and no-face jobs (TZ 5.5, 11.4); the refund itself is the backend's.

spec.description: Pipeline facts: voice policy, speakers, faces, head pose, lip-sync frame verdict.

errors.description: Technical error lines for the logs (not for the user).
